fields.name: pots_hr_criterion_met
fields.label: POTS HR criterion met
fields.rule: **C; required when and only when `pots_applicable` is TRUE, and rejected when it is FALSE.** **YES only when, within ten minutes of head-up tilt or standing, a sustained heart-rate rise greater than 30 bpm from supine, or a sustained absolute heart rate greater than 120 bpm, occurred without meeting orthostatic-hypotension criteria** — the adult definition of the 2021 EFAS/AAS/EAN tilt-testing consensus, Section 12.1 reference 10, unchanged in v1.4 under `pots_adult_criterion` definition version v2. INDETERMINATE where the recording does not allow the judgement. NO where the criterion was assessed and not met. **Frozen consistency with `test_result`, enforced at finalization and jointly with `pots_clinical_criteria_met`:** `test_result = POTS` **requires** `pots_hr_criterion_met = YES` **and** `pots_clinical_criteria_met = YES`; `pots_hr_criterion_met = NO` **forbids** `test_result = POTS`; `pots_hr_criterion_met = INDETERMINATE` **cannot finalize as a definite POTS diagnosis** — the test finalizes with `test_result` recorded as the non-diagnostic or alternative classification the recording supports, never as POTS. A stored POTS result that contradicts the criterion is the exact defect this rule removes

fields.name: pots_clinical_criteria_met
fields.label: POTS clinical criteria met
fields.rule: **C; human-entered; required when and only when `pots_applicable` is TRUE, and rejected when it is FALSE.** The stored **clinical** half of the POTS diagnosis, which v1.3 had nowhere: v1.3 permitted `test_result = POTS` from the heart-rate criterion alone, even with `symptoms_or_syncope_reproduced = NO`, so a purely haemodynamic postural tachycardia was stored as a POTS diagnosis. **YES** means compatible **chronic** orthostatic-intolerance symptoms — recurrent lightheadedness, palpitations, weakness, blurred vision, or exercise intolerance on standing, present for at least three months — **and** no better explanatory condition documented (acute dehydration, active bleeding, anaemia, hyperthyroidism, medication effect, or deconditioning attributable to another cause). **NO** means the clinical criterion was assessed and not met. **INDETERMINATE** means the available history does not allow the judgement. **Necessity:** the 2021 EFAS/AAS/EAN consensus (Section 12.1 reference 10) treats POTS as a **clinical** diagnosis requiring orthostatic-intolerance symptoms **plus** documented postural tachycardia; a heart-rate number alone is a postural-tachycardia pattern, not POTS, and no other stored field carries the chronic-symptom and no-better-explanation judgement. `symptoms_or_syncope_reproduced` records what happened **during this test**, which is a different question from chronic orthostatic intolerance and cannot substitute for it. **Burden effect:** exactly **one** additional human-entered value, and only on a tilt test where `pots_applicable` is TRUE; **zero** on the Section 10.5 reference pathway, which contains no tilt test, and zero on every tilt test where POTS is neither the indication nor the result. **Frozen conjunction:** `test_result = POTS` **requires both** `pots_clinical_criteria_met = YES` **and** `pots_hr_criterion_met = YES`. Either field NO or INDETERMINATE forbids a definite POTS result; the test finalizes with the non-diagnostic or alternative classification the recording supports. **The existing EFAS haemodynamic threshold in `pots_hr_criterion_met` is unchanged**
